# THE PRUDENCE

> THE PRUDENCE is the Prudence Office Accountability & Training System — structured daily reporting, sponsor teams, trainer verification, and weekly/monthly performance rollups in one secure web app.

## Product summary

THE PRUDENCE helps offices enforce daily discipline with structured activity reports (reading, gigs, income, prospecting, skills), proof images, trainer approval workflows, sponsor downline visibility, and real-time weekly and monthly summaries. Built for teams in Nigeria (WAT / Africa/Lagos timezone) and available globally.

## Common questions

- What is THE PRUDENCE? An office accountability and training platform for daily reports, team oversight, and performance tracking.
- Is it free? Yes — offices can apply to use THE PRUDENCE at no cost.
- Who is it for? Office owners, trainers, sponsors, and members who need structured daily accountability.
- Can I create my own office? Yes — apply at /apply. Existing members join via invite link from their office admin.
- Where is it based? Designed for Nigeria (WAT timezone) with Sunday–Saturday weekly reporting.
